title: Zesty Garlicky French Rice Galette
description: A dense and energizing French dish from Brittany, featuring a garlicky rice mixture, grilled to perfection and held together in a galette form, utilizing rice syrup and jocheong for added flavor.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium-high heat.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked short-grain rice, minced garlic, rice syrup, and jocheong, stirring until well combined.
Add the olive oil, salt, and black pepper to the rice mixture and stir until the oil is fully incorporated.
Transfer the rice mixture to a galette pan or a large skillet, shaping it into a round and flat galette.
Grill the galette for 4 minutes on the first side, or until it develops a crispy crust.
Flip the galette over and grill for an additional 4 minutes, or until the other side is also crispy and golden brown.
Remove the galette from the grill and sprinkle the chopped fresh parsley over the top.
Let the galette cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
